info.name: Golden Wing Warlock
info.description: Drahon’s Essence is an Otherworldly Patron option for the warlock, born from the surviving essence of the dead god-dragon Drahon the Golden.

description.p: Drahon the Golden was slain, but his death did not extinguish his power. Fragments of his divine essence, known by some as Golden Embers, still cling to living souls, ancient relics, holy trees, and the blood of dragons. A Golden Wing Warlock carries one of these fragments.

This bond is not an ordinary pact. Drahon does not speak from a distant plane or demand service through whispered commands. His essence survives as instinct, memory, and purpose: preserve life, stand against terror, restore what can be restored, and become the shield when no other shield remains.

The first sign of this bond is a celestial creature called a Golden Sentinel. As the Warlock grows stronger, the Sentinel is revealed to be more than a servant. It is the visible half of the same divine fragment burning within the Warlock.
The essence within each Golden Wing Warlock can manifest differently. Choose or create one sign of the pact.

tr.td: Fine golden cracks appear across your skin when you protect another creature.
Your shadow displays draconic wings whenever you confront something you fear.
Your heartbeat is joined by a distant second heartbeat while your Sentinel is present.
Your blood briefly shines like molten gold when exposed to air.
Your voice carries a deep draconic resonance when you invoke Drahon’s name.
Warm golden embers drift from your body whenever you restore life or consciousness.

sheet.description: A Golden Wing Warlock carries a living fragment of the dead god-dragon Drahon: a golden celestial spirit called a Golden Sentinel.

description.p: Drahon’s Essence lets you choose from an expanded list of spells when you learn a warlock spell. The following spells are added to the warlock spell list for you.

td.em: aura of life, guardian of faith

sheet.description: Drahon’s Essence lets you choose from an expanded list of spells when you learn a warlock spell.

description.p: When you choose this patron at 1st level, Drahon’s Essence manifests beside you as a Golden Sentinel. It is a Tiny celestial spirit that resembles a golden-winged drake, bird, or another small creature associated with Drahon. Its appearance does not change its statistics.
The Sentinel is friendly to you and your companions, and it obeys your commands. It uses the Golden Sentinel stat block, which uses your proficiency bonus in several places.

The Sentinel acts immediately after your turn. It can move and use its reaction on its own, but it takes the Dodge action unless you use a bonus action on your turn to command it to take the Dash, Disengage, Help, Hide, or Search action. If you are incapacitated, the Sentinel can take any of these actions without being commanded.
The Sentinel cannot make attacks.

While the Sentinel is within 100 feet of you, you can communicate with it telepathically. As an action, you can see through its eyes and hear what it hears until the start of your next turn, gaining the benefits of its senses. During this time, you are blind and deaf to your own surroundings.

The Sentinel can expend 5 feet of movement to perch on you or another willing creature in its space. While perched, it shares the creature’s space, cannot be targeted or damaged, and cannot move or take actions. It can still use Golden Warning. The Sentinel can leave its perch at the start of its turn without expending movement.
While the Sentinel is perched on you, you gain the following benefits:

ul.li: You gain darkvision out to 60 feet. If you already have darkvision, its range increases by 30 feet.
You add your Charisma modifier to Wisdom (Perception) checks and to your passive Wisdom (Perception) score.
You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

description.p: If the Sentinel is reduced to 0 hit points, it disappears in a burst of warm golden light. It returns with all its hit points when you finish a short or long rest. You can also restore it as an action by expending a warlock spell slot, causing it to appear in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you with all its hit points.

sheet.description: You gain the service of the Golden Sentinel, a Tiny celestial spirit that acts immediately after your turn, taking the Dodge action unless you command it to Dash, Disengage, Help, Hide, or Search. It cannot make attacks. While the Sentinel is within 100 feet of you, you can communicate with it telepathically, and as an action you can see through its eyes and hear what it hears until the start of your next turn. The Sentinel can perch on you or a willing creature. While it is perched on you, you gain darkvision out to 60 feet (or +30 feet if you already have darkvision), you add your Charisma modifier to Wisdom (Perception) checks and your passive Perception, and you have advantage on saving throws against being frightened. If the Sentinel is reduced to 0 hit points, it disappears and returns with all its hit points at the end of a short or long rest, or immediately by expending a warlock spell slot as an action.

description.p: The visible half of a divine fragment of Drahon’s Essence: a golden celestial spirit that is friendly to you and your companions and obeys your commands.
Proficiency Bonus (PB) equals your proficiency bonus

setters.set: Dex +3 plus PB, Wis +2 plus PB
Perception +2 plus PB, Stealth +3 plus PB
darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 12 plus PB
understands the languages you speak; telepathy with you while within 100 ft.

description.p: The Sentinel adds your proficiency bonus to any ability check or saving throw it makes that does not already include that bonus.

sheet.description: The Sentinel adds your proficiency bonus to any ability check or saving throw it makes that does not already include that bonus.

description.p: The Sentinel does not provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy’s reach.

sheet.description: The Sentinel does not provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy’s reach.

description.p: The Sentinel can shed bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. It can ignite or extinguish this light without using an action.

sheet.description: The Sentinel can shed bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. It can ignite or extinguish this light without using an action.

description.p: When the creature on which the Sentinel is perched is hit by an attack, the Sentinel adds your proficiency bonus to that creature’s Armor Class against the triggering attack, potentially causing the attack to miss.
The Sentinel can use Golden Warning a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus. It regains all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

sheet.description: When the creature on which the Sentinel is perched is hit by an attack, the Sentinel adds your proficiency bonus to that creature’s Armor Class against the triggering attack, potentially causing the attack to miss.

description.p: Starting at 6th level, your bond reveals that you and the Golden Sentinel are two manifestations of the same divine ember.

As a bonus action while the Sentinel is within 100 feet of you, you can merge it into your body for 10 minutes. The Sentinel disappears, immense spectral wings form behind you, and you gain the following benefits for the duration:

ul.li: You gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed plus 10 feet and can hover.
You shed dim golden light in a 10-foot radius. You can suppress or restore this light without using an action.
Golden Warning can protect you or any creature you can see within 30 feet of you. Because the Sentinel is merged with you, you use your reaction to activate Golden Warning.
When Golden Warning causes an attack to miss, the protected creature can immediately move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

description.p: The transformation ends early if you are incapacitated or if you end it as a bonus action. When it ends, the Sentinel appears in your space or in the nearest unoccupied space.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

sheet.description: While the Sentinel is within 100 feet of you, you can merge it into your body for 10 minutes, until you end it as a bonus action, or until you are incapacitated. While merged, you gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed plus 10 feet and can hover, you shed dim golden light in a 10-foot radius, and Golden Warning can protect you or any creature you can see within 30 feet of you (using your reaction); when it causes an attack to miss, the protected creature can immediately move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks. When the transformation ends, the Sentinel appears in your space or the nearest unoccupied space.

description.p: Starting at 10th level, Drahon’s Essence refuses to allow a protected soul to be extinguished. You gain resistance to necrotic and radiant damage, and you have advantage on death saving throws.

sheet.description: You gain resistance to necrotic and radiant damage, and you have advantage on death saving throws.

description.p: Also at 10th level, when you or a creature you can see within 30 feet of the Golden Sentinel is reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, the Sentinel can use its reaction to intervene. While the Sentinel is merged with you through One Soul, Two Wings, measure this range from you instead.
The dying creature drops to 1 hit point instead and gains temporary hit points equal to your warlock level + your Charisma modifier.

The Sentinel then disappears. If it was merged with you, that transformation immediately ends. A Sentinel sacrificed this way cannot be restored with a spell slot or a short rest; it returns when you finish a long rest.
Once the Sentinel uses this reaction, it cannot do so again until you finish a long rest.

sheet.description: When you or a creature you can see within 30 feet of the Golden Sentinel (or within 30 feet of you, while the Sentinel is merged with you) is reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, the Sentinel can intervene: the dying creature drops to 1 hit point instead and gains temporary hit points equal to your warlock level + your Charisma modifier. The Sentinel then disappears and cannot be restored with a spell slot or a short rest until you finish a long rest.

description.p: Starting at 14th level, you can release the memory of Drahon’s final defiance, transforming the Golden Sentinel into the shadow of a colossal golden dragon.

As an action, choose yourself or your Golden Sentinel as the point of origin. If you choose the Sentinel, it must be within 100 feet of you. A spectral dragon unfurls its wings from that point and releases divine light in a 30-foot cone.

Each hostile creature in the cone must make a Constitution saving throw against your warlock spell save DC. On a failed save, a creature takes 8d8 radiant damage and is blinded until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and is not blinded.
Each creature of your choice in the cone regains hit points equal to 4d8 + your Charisma modifier. A creature healed in this way can immediately end one effect causing it to be charmed or frightened.

After the light fades, golden spectral feathers and scales remain suspended in the air until the start of your next turn. The affected area is bright light during that time, and magical darkness created by a spell of 5th level or lower is dispelled within it.
Once you use this feature, you cannot use it again until you finish a long rest.

sheet.description: Choose yourself or your Golden Sentinel (within 100 feet of you) as the point of origin. A spectral dragon unfurls its wings and releases divine light in a 30-foot cone. Each hostile creature in the cone makes a Constitution saving throw against your warlock spell save DC, taking 8d8 radiant damage and being blinded until the end of your next turn on a failure, or half damage and no blindness on a success. Each creature of your choice in the cone regains 4d8 + your Charisma modifier hit points and can immediately end one effect causing it to be charmed or frightened. The affected area sheds bright light and dispels magical darkness of 5th level or lower until the start of your next turn.
